title: Geospatial Explorer · Synthetic Demo
source_description: Procedural Cartesian fixture. No real campus, survey, or third-party geographic dataset.
about_summary: Four fictional buildings, a sloped ground grid, a road and a path demonstrate the reusable viewer.
about_limitations: Coordinates and elevations are synthetic. Replace the scene directory with verified exports for a real project.
project_description: Reusable Three.js explorer template from the Open Geospatial-to-3D Reconstruction Pipeline.
footer: Synthetic demonstration. No real location is represented.
